question: Which location in the Anadyr Timezone has the biggest population?
sparql:
PREFIX  uom:  <http://www.opengis.net/def/uom/OGC/1.0/>
PREFIX  owl:  <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX  rdf:  <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX  ns:   <http://rdf.freebase.com/ns/>
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT  ?loc
WHERE
  { ?tz  rdf:type    ns:time.time_zone ;
         rdfs:label  ?label
    FILTER contains(lcase(?label), "anadyr")
    ?tz  ns:time.time_zone.locations_in_this_time_zone  ?loc
    OPTIONAL
      { ?loc  ns:topic_server.population_number  ?pop }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?loc  ns:location.statistical_region.population  ?pop2 }
    BIND(coalesce(?pop, ?pop2, 0) AS ?population)
  }
ORDER BY DESC(?population)
LIMIT   1
